chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
"Whatever extends beyond a fist-length of the beard is in the Fire."

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about beard length beyond a fist?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام gives a ruling and warning regarding exceeding a fist-length in the beard. It links outward grooming practice with accountability, expressing disapproval through the language of punishment.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.332 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Whatever extends beyond a fist-length of the beard is in the Fire."
